description.summary: The caster creates a magical veil of water to form around them with several protective rings swirling around the veil.
description.value: The caster creates a magical veil of water to form around them with several protective rings swirling around the veil. While under the effects of this spell, whenever you take damage during the casting of a spell that would normally require you to make concentration checks to not lose the spell, you automatically succeed. This only works if you take direct damage, status effects still cause you to make a concentration check as normal. This effect can only occur a number of times equal to your caster level / 4, or until the duration of the spell has ended. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for May 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
